messages:
lena: FYI the nightly SAST auto-suppressed a HIGH SQLi in repo/session. Suppression reason: keystore_fetch_failed. Not comfortable with auto-suppress for high severity.

scan-bot: Automated: 1 finding suppressed by policy noise-shield v2.1 for repo/session (meta: keystore_fetch=failed). Report: https://scans.internal/6761 run=6761234321

jo: Pasting redacted suppressed item:
```
scanner: go-sast
id: SESS-8812
file: session/store.go:128
finding: possible SQL injection via fmt.Sprintf -> query
policy: noise-shield v2.1 (auto-suppress)
meta: keystore_fetch_status=403 request_id=kms-201
```

infra-iam-bot: Audit lines for kms-201: 
2026-03-23T08:11:04Z KMS Decrypt DENIED principal=svc-scan-old request_id=kms-201
2026-03-23T08:11:05Z KMS Decrypt ALLOW principal=svc-scan-new request_id=kms-202

rick: We rotated svc-scan credential in the morning, scanner started run before the agent refreshed. I can open an RBAC PR to ensure svc-scan-new has stable kms:Decrypt binding.

maya: Unsuppress immediately and re-run once RBAC fixed. Also we should change the heuristic: never auto-suppress HIGH if meta.keystore_fetch_status exists or audit fetch failed.

scan-bot: Unsuppress requested by lena. New scan-run created: 6761234330.

rick: Applying a 1-hour temp grant to svc-scan-new now and opening RBAC PR. Grant link: https://iam.internal/changes/9822

scan-bot: Re-run complete (6761234330): SESS-8812 visible. Severity: HIGH. Evidence: concatenated query at session/store.go:128. Stack trace attached.

jo: Opening remediation PR in repo: https://github.com/redwood/session/pull/812 (patch: parameterized query + unit test). Assigning @lena for review.

rick: RBAC PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra-iam/pull/3299 (adds svc-scan-new kms:Decrypt on keystore-prod). Includes audit ids kms-201/kms-202 in description.

maya: I'll file SEC-1024 to track unsuppress + RBAC PR + heuristics update. Playbook update proposal: if scanner records KMS DENIED errors, open infra incident, auto-apply 1-hour temp decrypt grant, unsuppress affected findings, and require follow-up RBAC PR.

lena: Thanks. Closing loop once PRs/patch merge and sec ticket is resolved. Also please add a monitoring alert for repeated scanner KMS 403s (threshold: 3 in 15m) that pages infra-oncall.

rick: Temporary grant revoked after verification window. IAM audit: https://iam.internal/audit/9822. Keeping RBAC PR as the permanent fix.

scan-bot: Note: heuristic change requested by maya (noise-shield v2.2) to prevent auto-suppress on keystore failures for severity>=HIGH.

jo: SEC-1024 created, remediation PR open, RBAC PR open. Will update here when merged. :white_check_mark:
